snippet.title: King's Quest 8: Mask of Eternity gameplay (PC Game, 1998)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for King's Quest 8: Mask of Eternity, PC game produced by Sierra in 1998 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/king-s-quest-8-mask-of-eternity/6774/
The story of King's Quest 8: Mask of Eternity is very interesting, you must travel to in order to find and recover the missing pieces of the Mask. It is a game full of action, a 3D adventure.
Played through modern Windows machine.
Recorded with original sound.
